description: ApplicationGroupPolicy is polymorphic on `type`; the converted model keeps only the base members, so S.Struct strips the ThrottlingPolicy payload (`rateLimitThreshold`, `metricId`) on encode and decode, and ARM rejects a throttling policy without them. Add the ThrottlingPolicy subtype members to the base shape.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: ThrottlingPolicy: the threshold limit above which the application group will be throttled. Rate limit is always per second.
ThrottlingPolicy: metric to throttle on (IncomingBytes, OutgoingBytes, IncomingMessages, OutgoingMessages).
